content.text: ▪︎ACOG: reserved (w/ estrogen HT) for pts who can't tolerate other osteoporosis therapies
admin: IM; SQ; nasal spray (only 1 nostril, alt nostrils each day)
SE: inj site rxn       -    rhinitis    -   nasal congest
Class: RANK ligand Ab -human IgG2 monoclonal Ab
need for osteoclast form/funct/survival & role in bone resorb
skin rxn: cellulitis, eczema, derm, rash     -  jaw osteonecrosis
Guidelines: lowest effective dose for shortest duration
Only prevent osteoporosis -> FDA = ⍉estrogen prod first
▪︎⍉routine osteoporosis prev: risks generally outweigh skeletal benefits → reserved for a narrow subgroup; ACOG: reserved (w/ calcitonin) for pts who can't tolerate other osteoporosis therapies
MI, CVA, PE, DVT, & breast CA
MOA: agonist in some tissues & antagonist in others
SE: arthralgias - hot flashes - periph edema - sweating
take in AM on empty stomach
SE: esophageal erosion     -    GI distress: diarrhea

: potent inhibitors of bone resorption; bind to hydroxyapatite crystals in bone & antagonize osteoclast activity; osteoclast activate, form, & recruitment are inhibited, & life span = ↓; increase osteoblast prolif & intestinal calcium absorb
: first line tx/prev of OP in most pts
: esophagitis, MSK sxs, hypocalcemia, GI (oral) – abd pain, dyspepsia, N/V, dysphagia, heartburn
: osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ), atypical femur fractures – limit tx to 3-5yrs in pts w/ ↓risk of frx
: caution in pts w/ aspirin-sensitive asthma – can induce bronchoconstrict
•Estrogen Agonist: bone (↓ resorption), lipids, coag system
•Estrogen Antagonist: breast, uterus (↓ risk of breast CA & endometrial CA)
: tx or prev in postmenopausal women
: vasomotor sxs (hot flashes), GU atrophy, periph edema, arthralgia, leg cramps/musc spasms, flu sxs, infections
: RANKL inhibitor – results in ↓bone resorption & ↑bone mass & strength
: used for tx when there = a ↑risk of frx in pts who cannot adhere to or tolerate oral bisphosphonates
: serious systemic/skin infections, dermatologic rxns (derm, eczema, rashes), ONJ

: functionally antagonizes the effects of PTH; directly inhibits osteoclastic bone resorption; promotes the renal excretion of calcium, phosphate, sodium, magnesium, and potassium by decreasing tubular reabsorb; increases the jejunal secretion of H2O, sodium, potassium, and Cl

: last line therapy/⍉recommended – used for pts who cannot tolerate or fail alendronate or raloxifene therapy; only recommended as a tx option for women >5yr postmenopausal who cannot tolerate any other OP med
: back pain, myalgia, nausea, dizziness, inj (flushing & inj site rxns)
: hypocalcemia (assoc w/ tetany/seizures), ↑risk of malig w/ long-term use, hypersensitivity to salmon-derived prod, Ab form, nasal spray (nasal ulcerations, epistaxis, rhinitis)
